title: Base change for native compactly supported Weil direct images
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the categories $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(-)$ and the actual equivariant derived operations $h^*,Rh_*,Rh_{0!}$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Consider a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] of $k_0$-schemes and $k_0$-morphisms
$$\begin{array}{ccc}X'&\xrightarrow{g}&X\\ f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\ Y'&\xrightarrow{h}&Y\end{array}$$
where $f$ and $f'$ are separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], quasi-compact and locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and $Y$ and $Y'$ are quasi-compact, quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism] and locally of finite type over $k_0$. No hypothesis is put on $g$ and $h$ beyond being $k_0$-morphisms. Then there is an isomorphism of functors on the native derived Weil categories
$$h^*\circ Rf_{0!}\ \cong\ Rf'_{0!}\circ g^*:\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X)\longrightarrow\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y'),$$
where $Rf_{0!}$, $Rf'_{0!}$ are the compactly supported direct images built from the chosen compactifications. Only the existence of a natural isomorphism is asserted; it lies in the categories of Weil complexes, hence is equivariant.

proof.text: Choose the compactification c of f and form c' by Compactification.ofIsPullback hH. Add the induced over, locally finite type and quasi-compact instances. The pullback identities from the compactification base-change theorem give chosen Cartesian squares for the proper maps c'.g over c.g and for the open immersions c'.i over c.i.

proof.text: Apply native proper natural base change to the chosen proper square and native open natural base change to the chosen open square. Whisker these isomorphisms with the compactification model comparisons and the full-subcategory inclusion comparisons, using associators, to obtain an ambient isomorphism between the two composites. Full faithfulness of the inclusion of the target Weil-complex subcategory gives the required preimage isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_upperStar_derivedLowerShriek_iso {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [X'.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [Y'.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {f : X ⟶ Y} [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} [f'.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsSeparated f']
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f'] [QuasiCompact f']
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y' ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y' ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiSeparated (Y' ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {g : X' ⟶ X} [g.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] {h : Y' ⟶ Y}
    [h.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] (hH : IsPullback g f' f h) :
    Nonempty (derivedLowerShriek k₀ l f ⋙ upperStar h ≅ upperStar g ⋙ derivedLowerShriek k₀ l f') :=
  sorry
